name: Opaque Hourglass

perks.name: Mag-lev Rail
perks.desc:
Magnetic levitation massively decreases friction, allowing higher bolt velocity.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases persistence

perks.name: Empowered Rail
perks.desc:
Imbuing a rail with paracausal energy improves the durability and effect duration of bolts.
  •  Greatly increases persistence
  •  Decreases handling speed

perks.name: Ultralight Rail
perks.desc:
Lightweight rail construction makes it easier to handle.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases reload speed

perks.name: Quickload Rail
perks.desc:
A streamlined rail speeds up operations.
  •  Greatly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: Low-Profile Rail
perks.desc:
A pared-down rail improves weapon usability.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases persistence

perks.name: Frictionless Rail
perks.desc:
Reducing friction on the rail allows for faster loading and higher velocity.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Increases projectile speed

perks.name: Explosive Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts explode shortly after hitting the environment or a target, but deal less damage on impact.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Spring-Auger Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts release an impulse shortly after impact that deals a small amount of damage and has a high chance to cause flinch.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Charged Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts attached to targets deal damage over time.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Serrated Bolts
perks.desc:
Recovering a bolt from a living target deals damage.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Heavy Bolts
perks.desc:
Bolts deal increased damage, but are slower and more affected by gravity.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

perks.name: Sympathetic Arsenal
perks.desc: Reloading after a final blow also reloads stowed weapons.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Firefly
perks.desc: Precision kills with this weapon increase reload speed and cause the target to explode, dealing Solar damage to nearby enemies.

perks.name: Rolling Storm
perks.desc:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge.

perks.name: Bolt Scavenger
perks.desc: Recovering a bolt increases reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Wellspring
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

perks.name: Impulse Amplifier
perks.desc: Massively increases projectile velocity, increases reload speed.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Firing Line
perks.desc: This weapon deals increased precision damage when near two or more allies.

perks.name: Master of Arms
perks.desc: Kills with any weapon improve this weapon's damage for a short time.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.desc: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Frame of Reference
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, reload speed, and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.

notes: Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Boss PvE-BossSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for sustained damage against bosses in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content. Being honest, Opaque Hourglass - like the other high-impact frame crossbow - is difficult to define a role for. It's a bit slow for burst damage in short damage windows, but because you can recover bolts manually or with a Shoot to Loot weapon as part of a damage rotation, you can effectively have infinite ammo so might be more useful for sustained damage. The stats are good by comparison with its peers, and they're helped further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/1553681400 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From @mossy_max's spreadsheet (https://destiny2.science/reserves), total ammo is 10. Gut instinct is to improve Handling with the rail perk, or maybe boost velocity or reload speed without any other maluses. With the bolt perk, Charged Bolts adds a little damage over time - but this is instanced so multiple hits don't increase this DoT - or Serrated Bolts deals damage when you recover a bolt. For a sustained damage roll, as there are no auto-reload trait perks available, Impulse Amplifier passively boosts projectile velocity by ×1.35, and +20 Reload Speed (+25 when enhanced) with a ×0.85/0.8* animation scalar or Field Prep grants +50 Reload Speed with a ×0.8 animation scalar to both reload and ready/stow when crouched and bumps Ammo Generation by +30 (+55 Reload Speed and +40 Ammo Generation enhanced). There's also Bolt Scavenger which boosts Handling and Reload Speed for 4s after collecting a bolt - picking up additional bolts extend this by 3s each up to 15s max. In the second column, Frenzy boosts Handling and Reload Speed by +100 and boosts damage by ×1.15 for a refreshable 7.2s after being in combat for 12s - that's dealing or taking damage. The Frame of Reference Origin Trait stacks up to ×5 times on kills, providing up to ×1.07 damage and boosts to Reload Speed and Range for 8s, with the timer pausing when the weapon's stowed. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
